tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje khyung khra'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bsdus tshang 'jug bde bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ 'dir rdo rje khyung khra'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ni/ thab 'og gi bskyed chog bzhin gyi dbus su pad nyi la tshon spungs ljang khu'am 'bru tshom gcig bkod/ de'i kha khyer steng nas bud shing ngam/ lci gtsang brtsigs na shar lhor ting lo bzhag rgyun bzhag gam 'o ma can btsugs pa'i me/ bsreg rdzas mchod rdzas/ ku sha brgyad rang nyid shar bltas kyi stan de'i g.yas nas yam shing / mar/ til/ zas mchog so ba/ 'bras/ nas/ gro/ sran/ dur wa/ ku sha rnams gso chas bcas dang / g.yon nas khyung gtor/ chu gnyis nyer mchod lnga/ me lha'i zlum gtor/ mdun du rdor dril bar dgang blugs/ bsang chu thor g.yab rnams bshams/ rang nyid gos rgyan dkar po skyil krung ngam tsog pu'i shar bltas 'dug la/ sdig sogs zhi sems bya ste 'byor ba'i chos drug go /dngos gzhi ni mchod pa byin rlabs nas bdag bskyed rdzogs bar bsnyen pa bzhin/ gong gi mes spor lde sbar la/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swāhā/ lan gsum gyis thab la bskor te/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes nang gi ting lo sbar/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang blugs mar bkang / sngags des lan gsum bud shing khyab par bya/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdun nam nyer gcig sogs ci rigs brjod pas bsang chu sgrub pa sngags de brjod cing / ku shas mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams la gtor/ swa bhā was sbyang ba sogs mchod pa byin rlabs bzhin la/ byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i sreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhās yam shing / oṃ shrī swāhās mar/ oṃ dz+riṃ swāhās 'bru/ oṃ swa swāhās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhās rdzas thams cad sbyangs/ mchod sngags mchod pa byin rlabs bzhin dang /

thab swā bha wās stong par sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ kha khyer ram mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ phyi rol tu stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las me lha ra skyes la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas bgrang phreng / g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba gsus khyim che ba ral pa'i thor gtsug can ag tshom 'phyang ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas bstim: slar yang rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas dbang lha spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chu'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du rol mo'i bar 'gre/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍā ki'i dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gi nyon mongs thams cad bsregs/ /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/

/ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa thams cad sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig oṃ badz+ra satwa a/ zhes brjod de thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas skor du dgram mo/ /de nas gzar bu gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ste/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la raṃ bsam dgang blugs kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang raṃ bsams te/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ zhes lan bdun brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī pyā dī pyā ma ha shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha nā ya swāhā/ lan gsum gyis byon zan phul la bar der me'i pra brtags te ngan na hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsangs chu'i phyogs kun tu gtor te bgegs bsal lo/ /de nas me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa lngas mchod la/ yam shing la sogs pa 'og nas 'byung ba'i bsreg rdzas rnam rim pa bzhin lag pa g.yon du bzung la g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas blang zhing cung zad bskor te mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul/ de yang yam shing byang chub kyi shing du mos te/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ya swāhā/ zhes pas bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pa phul ba'i mar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ya/ bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang / gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang de'i rigs pas shes par byas la/

oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ zhes pas mar dang / oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya swāhā/ zhes pas til lam yungs dkar dang / oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhās zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog dang / oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swāhās 'bras so ba dang / oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swāhās 'bras dang / oṃ ma hā be gā ya swāhās nas dang / oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swāhās gro dang / oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swāhās sran ma dang / oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swāhās dur ba dang / oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya swāhās ku sha rnams phul la sde tshan re re'i mthar gong ltar gyi spel tshig sbyar ro/ /mchod bstod gong bzhin mar blugs gzar dgang thab tu blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sogs rjes gnang bzhin ye shes pa bstim pa'i bar byas la de'i sku las 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par gyur/ slar yang hūm̐ zhes brjod cing thab dang yo byad thams cad la bsang chus gtor te mi gtsang ba dang nyes pa thams cad dag par bsam mo/ /de nas gzar bu gnyis blang ste zhal cung zad gdangs par bsams pa sogs sngar ltar gsal btab ste/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swāhā/ zhes lan 'ga' zhig brjod pas mar la bsngags te/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ zhes pa lan bdun gyi blugs gzar gyi mar blugs pas/ dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī pyā dī pyā/ zhes sogs kyi mthar/ bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i/ zhes sogs spel tshig gong ltar brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la zhal du phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum la sogs pas byon skyems phul la/ rjes gnang bzhin mchod bstod/ de nas yam shing nas brtsams te bsreg rdzas rnams sde tshan re re'i thog mar/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swāhā/

tshar gsum mam lnga la sogs pa dang / mjug tu spel tshig gong ltar brjod cing logs nas sgrub g.yog gcig gis grangs bzung / bsnyen pa kha gso la sogs pa'i dus su nub re la til stong phrag lnga'am/ khri la sogs pa ji tsam nus pa 'bul zhing skabs skabs su yam shing dang mar ci 'byor pa 'bul/ sgrub g.yog gcig gis me rgyun ma chad pa tsam gyis bud shing yang 'jug go /rdzogs pa dang gong byon skyems kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blugs gsum phul mchod bstod gong bzhin/ gtor ma rjes gnang bzhin/ thal mo sbyar te/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs rang gi yid la gang 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab la skabs 'dir yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /zhes sogs dang / bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas sems sgrib pa dang ldan pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / bying ba dang / rgod pa'i dbang gis cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa thams cad bzod par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces sogs kyi mthar/ badz+ra muḥ ces dang mtheb srin gyis se gol gyi sgras/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ srin lag gis thab kyi thal ba cung zad blangs la dpral bar bkus te dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo/ /dngos gzhi'i chos drug go /thab khung du mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la rig pa dang bcas pas blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsam la bsreg rdzas rnams kyi lhag ma bdun nam bcu gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor phul mthar byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gang ba'i sbyin sreg tu phul/

yon bdag la sogs pa'i don du byed na de'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong dgang gzar dang lhan cig tu bzung la gang ba'i sbyin bsreg phul ba'i mthar/ bdag gam yon bdag che ge mo zhes bgyi ba'i nad dang gdon dang bkra mi shis pa dang byur dang skal ba ngan pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes bdun tshan gsum po re re'i mthar bya'o/ /gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas byin gyis rlabs/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ/ zhes sogs gsum mam lngas phul mtshan sngags re re nas sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod bstod gong bzhin/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i/ zhes sogs 'dod don gsol ba gong ltar bya'o/ /yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyi sgrub kyin gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ ag+na ye gats+tsha/ zhes dang / dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed de/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs dam tshig pa rang la thim/ gnas gsum bsrungs te/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci shes bya'o/ /me shi ba dang thal ba rang gis phyags la gnas dben par bskyal la rjes kyi chos drug go /zhes rdo rje khyung khra'i sbyin sreg 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rdo rje khyung khra'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bsdus tshang 'jug bde/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
